draft.text: You came in because your IBS symptoms have gotten worse.
This includes belly pain, nausea, and vomiting.
You said eating out more, especially on weekends, has made your symptoms worse.
We did not do any tests or check your body during this visit.
Your symptoms seem to be linked to spicy or fatty foods and drinking alcohol.
You have had similar problems before with the same triggers.
You will keep using medicines like Bentyl and Zofran when needed.
You should avoid foods and drinks that trigger your symptoms.
You might want to track what you eat and how you feel in a food diary.
Come back for a check-up if your symptoms get worse or don't improve.
